Abdulaziz Hatem.note: Hatem is midfield insurance for Qatar. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Abdulaziz Hatem.noteZh: 他给Qatar一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Ahmed Alaaeldin.note: Alaaeldin is attacking depth for Qatar. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Ahmed Alaaeldin.noteZh: 他是Qatar前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Ahmed Alganehi.summary: Ahmed Al-Ganehi is a Qatari professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Al-Gharafa and the Qatar national team.
Ahmed Alganehi.note: Al-Ganehi is attacking depth for Qatar. If the game slows down, he is there to make the back line move again.
Ahmed Alganehi.noteZh: 他是Qatar前场计划的一部分。他先拉扯防守者，再寻找把压力变成机会的触球。

Ahmed Fathy.note: Fathy is midfield insurance for Qatar. He is there for the messy phase: second ball, one calmer touch, then the next pass.
Ahmed Fathy.noteZh: 他给Qatar一种在比赛打开后稳住中路的办法。最好的工作，是让下一次决定没那么急。

Akram Afif.note: Afif is one of Qatar's attacking paths this tournament. Watch how the first defender reacts when he receives facing goal.
Akram Afif.noteZh: 他现在会出现在对手的赛前报告里。对Qatar来说，他的触球可以把协防从下一个跑动上拉走。

Alhashmi Alhussein.note: Al-Hussain gives Qatar cover for the minutes when defending becomes more about nerve than shape. One solid duel can calm the whole line.
Alhashmi Alhussein.noteZh: 他是Qatar后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Almoez Ali.note: Ali gives Qatar a route when possession needs to become pressure. He is there to make a defender choose.
Almoez Ali.noteZh: 他是Qatar这届赛事中被重点使用的进攻路线之一。他先让第一名防守者移动，再让终结或最后一传出现。

Assim Madibo.note: Madibo is the midfielder Qatar can use when the attack needs a softer touch. One clean receive can change the angle.
Assim Madibo.noteZh: 他给Qatar提供中场深度，适合比赛被拉开的时候。他把松散球变成更冷静的下一脚。

Ayoub Aloui.summary: Ayoub Mohamed Aloui is a Qatari defender who plays for Al-Gharafa and has represented Qatar at youth and senior national-team level.
Ayoub Aloui.note: Aloui is defensive rotation for Qatar. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Ayoub Aloui.noteZh: 他是Qatar艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Boualem Khoukhi.note: Khoukhi gives Qatar one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Boualem Khoukhi.noteZh: 他是Qatar无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Edmilson Junior.note: Junior has already created a goal for Qatar in this tournament. Watch the timing of his release, because the pass often matters more than the carry.
Edmilson Junior.noteZh: 他已经参与了Qatar的一粒世界杯进球。那脚传球的意义，是在防守者完全转身前到达。

Hassan Alhaydos.note: Al-Haydos is on the scoresheet for Qatar, with his goal coming against Bosnia and Herzegovina. One finish can change how opponents defend the next run.
Hassan Alhaydos.noteZh: 他已经把一次世界杯机会变成进球。接下来要看防守者会不会开始多给他一步空间。

Homam Ahmed.note: Ahmed is defensive rotation for Qatar. The watch point is how early he closes the lane that looked open.
Homam Ahmed.noteZh: 他是Qatar后防线的保险。卡片不华丽：赢球、稳传、重新站好。

Issa Laye.note: Laye has been part of Qatar's answer without the ball. He matters when the first runner has to be slowed before the whole shape breaks.
Issa Laye.noteZh: 他给Qatar后防线一个稳定零件。看的是那些小选择：上抢、站住，还是先封线路。

Jassem Gaber.note: Gaber gives Qatar one of the steady pieces in the back line. Watch the small choices: step, hold, or clear the lane.
Jassem Gaber.noteZh: 他是Qatar无球答案的一部分。第一个跑动被拖慢，整体阵型才不容易散。

Karim Boudiaf.note: Boudiaf is back-line insurance for Qatar. The card is not glamorous: win the ball, keep the pass safe, reset the shape.
Karim Boudiaf.noteZh: 他给Qatar那些靠胆量守住的分钟提供保障。一次扎实对抗就能让整条线冷静下来。

Lucas Mendes.note: Mendes is the kind of defender Qatar can turn to when the match gets narrow. His job is first contact, clean clearance, simple pass.
Lucas Mendes.noteZh: 他是Qatar艰难时间段的防守深度。他要赢下第一下接触，并让下一脚传球简单起来。

Mahmoud Abunada.note: Abunada has carried the keeper minutes for Qatar. The card is clean hands, clear restarts, and defenders who do not have to rush.
Mahmoud Abunada.noteZh: 他是Qatar防守结构最后的声音。压力停在禁区时，他要让下一步动作简单下来。

Meshaal Barsham.note: Barsham is Qatar's safety net in goal. The job is simple to say and hard to do: enter cold and make the box quieter.
Meshaal Barsham.noteZh: 他是Qatar的门将保障。角色是随时准备好扑救、重新开球，并在突然需要他时不慌。

Tahsin Mohammed.noteZh: 他是Qatar的进攻深度。如果比赛慢下来，他要让后防线重新移动。
